tools.name: check_email_security
tools.description: Email Security score for a domain with the DNS records found and the exact records to publish for each fix.

tools.name: check_discoverability
tools.description: Discoverability score for a domain: crawl access, site plumbing, page metadata, structured data and answer-engine readiness, with the exact file or tag to fix for each finding.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Both scores, the open fixes ranked by severity, and a saved report link (report_url) that opens the same findings without a rescan; share it as-is. Use this first for "is my domain set up right?" questions.

tools.name: fetch_as_crawler
tools.description: What Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot or GPTBot receive from the site: status, redirects, headers and extracted text. Shows CDN or firewall blocks that robots.txt cannot.

tools.name: verify_fix
tools.description: Re-runs only the checks behind one component (crawl, plumbing, metadata, structured, answer) and returns the updated score.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_security · Private data: check_email_security, check_discoverability · Public sink: check_email_security, get_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_security · Private data: check_email_security, check_discoverability · Public sink: check_email_security, get_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
